profile.ja: 魔力をおびた霧を操る高位魔族で『迷いの魔女』と呼ばれる。魔界においても秘境と呼ばれる地域に住み、限られた者とのみ交流を持っていた。彼女の住処は常に霧に覆われ、霧に含まれる魔力が意思に反応し、方向感覚を狂わせた上に幻覚を見せるため、悪意を持った侵入者は二度と出る事ができない。一方で悪意を持たない者や招待を受けた者は導かれるように屋敷へと誘導される。ただ、濃い霧によって道順は隠されているので、誰も屋敷の正確な位置を知ることはできない。彼女は子供好きで、迷い込んだ子供には菓子を与え、親元へと届けさせる事もある。子どもが好きなリリノーエは、ふと自身が子を成すとしたらどうなるのだろうと考えた。とは言え伴侶などは当然おらず、そもそも高位魔族の彼女を孕ませられる存在は極めて少ない。しかし、リリノーエはふと良いアイデアを思いつく。魔力を込めた霧によって自身の分身を作り、擬似的に体内へと収めたリリノーエは、楽しげに衣服や小道具を揃え、すっかり妊婦の姿となってイタズラっぽく微笑むのだった。
profile.en: She is a high-rank demon who commands mist infused with magical power and is known as the "Witch of the Lost." She dwells in a secluded region of the Demon Realm, interacting only with a select few. Her manor is perpetually shrouded in fog; the magic within the mist reacts to one's will, distorting sense of direction and conjuring hallucinations, so any malicious intruder can never escape. Those without ill intent or those who receive an invitation are gently guided to the manor, though the dense fog conceals the exact location, leaving no one aware of its true position. Lilinoe loves children and sometimes gives lost kids sweets, sending them back to their parents. Her demeanor is gentle, yet the aura of a high-rank demon radiates from her entire being, enough to intimidate ordinary demons merely by standing before her. Though both her magical power and combat ability are formidable, she finds no value in battle. Having lived through eternity, she rarely leaves her domain, and few seek her out, leaving her with abundant leisure. Occasionally she opens a small rift between the Demon Realm and the Human Realm, using the mist to lure humans. If a summoned human pleases her, she keeps them for a few days before returning them to the Human Realm; if not, she discards them into the fog.

text.ja: 今宵お呼び立てしたのは……ご相談したいことがあったからです。このお腹……誰の子か、おわかりになります？　ふふっ
text.en: I summoned you tonight because... I wanted to discuss something with you. This belly of mine... can you guess whose child it is? Hehe

text.ja: 招かれざるお客様にはお帰りいただいております。見ての通り身重ですから……不届きなお方のお相手はできませんの
text.en: I'm afraid I must ask uninvited guests to leave. As you can see, I'm pregnant... and I won't be able to entertain any improper visitors

text.ja: 私が……誰にでも身体を許すような軽い女に見えますか？　では……お腹の子が誰の子か、想像がついたようですね……♪
text.en: Do I look like the kind of woman who'd give her body to just anyone? Well... I suppose you can imagine whose child this is, can't you?

text.ja: 子供好きの私としましては、自分の子供ほど愛おしいものはありませんね。ああ……早く産まれてこないものでしょうか
text.en: As someone who loves kids, I can say that my own child is the most precious thing to me. Ah... I wish it would hurry up and be born already

text.ja: ああ、この衣装ですか？　ふふ、人の妊婦の格好を参考にしたのですよ。中々似合っていると思いませんか？
text.en: You like this outfit? Hehe, I based it on how human pregnant women dress. Don't you think it suits me?

text.ja: 私の方は準備万端ですよ。ほら、ベビー用品も十全に揃えてあります。いつ産まれても安心ですよ
text.en: I'm all ready on my end. See, I've got all the baby supplies I need. Don't worry, I'm all set for whenever the baby arrives

text.ja: 魔界の霧は……脅威からこの子を隠すことにも役立ちます。子供が大きくなるまで守ってあげるのは、私の役目です
text.en: The mist in the Demon Realm... will also help protect this child from harm. It's my duty to keep it safe until it grows up

text.ja: 身ごもってしまった以上は、あなたにも協力していただきませんと……。ふふふ、あなたなら、断りませんでしょう……？
text.en: Now that I'm pregnant, I'll need your cooperation... Hehehe, I'm sure you won't refuse, will you?
